name: @enzovezzaro/ai-auth-wallet
description: Browser wallet identity, signed capabilities, and peer connections for AI agents

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm test --prefix packages/runtime && npm test --prefix packages/mcp
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --test tests/e2e.test.mjs && node scripts/test-browser-e2e.mjs
scripts.verify:packages: node scripts/verify-npm-package.mjs . @enzovezzaro/ai-auth-wallet @enzovezzaro/ai-auth-wallet/agent-connect && node scripts/verify-npm-package.mjs packages/runtime @enzovezzaro/ai-auth-runtime && node scripts/verify-npm-package.mjs packages/mcp @enzovezzaro/ai-auth-mcp
scripts.format: prettier --write "packages/p2p/*.{js,d.ts}" "packages/runtime/**/*.{js,d.ts,mjs}" packages/runtime/README.md packages/runtime/CHANGELOG.md "packages/mcp/**/*.{js,d.ts,mjs}" "scripts/*.mjs" "tests/*.mjs" "docs/*.md" README.md CHANGELOG.md index.html landing.css styles.css apps/p2p/app.js package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "packages/p2p/*.{js,d.ts}" "packages/runtime/**/*.{js,d.ts,mjs}" packages/runtime/README.md packages/runtime/CHANGELOG.md "packages/mcp/**/*.{js,d.ts,mjs}" "scripts/*.mjs" "tests/*.mjs" "docs/*.md" README.md CHANGELOG.md index.html landing.css styles.css apps/p2p/app.js package.json
